notes: Ethereum mainnet HMM/IMD launch. HmmToken mints 1,000,000,000 HMM (18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the factory; it has no owner, subsequent mint or burn, transfer fee or transfer restriction. Deploy SwarmOracleAdapter before HmmMine atomically in the same launch transaction: the mine constructor calls bind(), moving no tokens. HmmMine has no steward argument; steward remains zero and nobody can change its adapter, action or rules. The action word is bytes32(oracle.request@oracle-1). The existing GenesisForwarder at economics.remainderTo is not deployed again; its registry is 0x7c9d5ee697bff5ac4f10e2e54d3f40c44e48fe23 and mineName is bytes32(HmmMine). After launch, anyone calls forward(launchNumber); it checks the registered token and mine, transfers its whole HMM balance to the mine and calls start(). The first start fixes the reserve and genesis with no delay. The pool allocation is 25% and the remainder allocation is 65%. The opening market cap is 10,000 IMD; pool.initialPrice is provenance only and the deployer derives the opening price from economics and supply. Anyone proposes validated questions, optionally with bounded definitions, and backs them with IMD. HmmMine builds the JSON and pays the live Intake price through requestWithFailure, naming the adapter as callback target. Only valid, unexpired, unused oracle-signed answers for the adapter with panel >= 5, quorum >= 4, agreed >= quorum and a majority credit the current 600-second round. Backers share rewards by actual IMD paid; 5% accrues to the fixed dev address. Emission halves every 15,552,000 seconds and stays within the initial reserve.
